limitations: Twenty-five detail rows on printed pp. 54–55 do not print activity/subactivity codes; these fields remain null in this reference and corresponding workbook raw metadata is not PDF-verified.
Account 5286A prints no line ID. Its line is null; no replacement identifier is invented.
Nineteen exact printed line titles differ from workbook labels. The PDF titles are retained here separately; workbook labels must remain attributable to the workbook.
Six printed p. 55 FY25 Enacted/Supplemental/Total triplets repeat the same value in all three columns. Each column is transcribed independently; published totals are not replaced with inferred sums.
